title: Assessing Modality Bias in Video Question Answering Benchmarks with Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the contribution of different input modalities (video vs. text/subtitles) to question answering by computing a Modality Importance Score (MIS) using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), and performing feature permutation experiments on state-of-the-art models to assess their reliance on specific modalities.
